## Which video model fits the shot you need? {#sc-compare-video-generation .fv-slide .sc-slide .sc-compare background-color="#ffffff"}

```{=html}
<div class="fv-meta"><span class="fv-id">S 69 / 95</span><span class="fv-cluster">LLM</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-image</span><span class="fv-cluster active">Text-to-video</span><span class="fv-cluster">Text-to-speech</span><span class="fv-cluster">Music</span><a class="sc-back" href="#/sc-toc">All models ↗</a></div>
<div class="sc-body cmp-body cmp-rows-5">
<p class="cmp-intro">A 20-second speaking shot needs duration, audio and reference controls at the same time</p>
<table class="cmp-table" aria-label="Which video model fits the shot you need?"><colgroup><col style="width:21%"><col style="width:25%"><col style="width:27%"><col style="width:27%"></colgroup><thead><tr><th scope="col">Model</th><th scope="col">Single generation</th><th scope="col">References / control</th><th scope="col">Constraint that changes the workflow</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2v-wan3">Wan3</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">≤30 s · 480p–1080p</span><span class="cmp-detail">30 fps · joint audio</span></td><td>≤20 files:<br>10 image + 5 video + 5 audio</td><td>Async preview API; usual generation time 1–5 min.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2v-flux-3-video">FLUX 3 Video</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">5–20 s · 24 fps</span><span class="cmp-detail">joint audio; FHD–4K upsampled</span></td><td>Up to 10 keyframe images;<br>draft → enhance</td><td>Larger output is upsampled; editing is a separate endpoint.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2v-kling-3-omni">Kling 3.0 Omni</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">3–15 s · 720p to 4K</span><span class="cmp-detail">native audio</span></td><td>Start/end frame; elements;<br>multi-shot</td><td>Video-reference input disables native audio.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2v-veo-3-1">Veo 3.1</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">4 / 6 / 8 s · 24 fps</span><span class="cmp-detail">audio; 4K at 8 s, not Lite</span></td><td>≤3 reference images on 3.1;<br>extension on 3.1 / Fast</td><td>A 20-second sequence requires extension or assembly.</td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><a href="#sc-t2v-seedance-2-5">Seedance 2.5</a></th><td><span class="cmp-primary">≤30 s · joint audio</span><span class="cmp-detail">BytePlus: 480p–1080p</span></td><td>≤50 refs:<br>30 image + 10 video + 10 audio</td><td>Dreamina 4K and API resolution are different claims.</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p class="cmp-caveat">Capability shortlist only: no quality or latency winner. Maximum duration and maximum resolution need not be available in every mode.</p>
</div>
<div class="fv-takeaway">For 20 seconds in one generation, these limits keep Wan3, FLUX 3 and Seedance in the shortlist.</div>
<div class="fv-source">Audit snapshot 18–19.10.2026 · reported results 21.10.2026 · source cards: <a href="#/sc-t2v-wan3">1</a> · <a href="#/sc-t2v-flux-3-video">2</a> · <a href="#/sc-t2v-kling-3-omni">3</a> · <a href="#/sc-t2v-veo-3-1">4</a> · <a href="#/sc-t2v-seedance-2-5">5</a> · linked cards retain original sources and conditions</div>
```

::: {.notes}
Предложите аудитории один заказ: двадцатисекундный говорящий персонаж с опорным изображением. По длительности остаются Wan, FLUX 3 и Seedance; у Kling и Veo понадобится другой способ сборки. После этого нужно проверить точную комбинацию режима, звука, разрешения и референсов. У Kling входное видео отключает native audio, что важнее общего значка наличия аудио. У FLUX высокие разрешения получаются upsampling. Время 1–5 минут у Wan — ожидание генерации, а 30 секунд — длина результата; это разные величины.

**Evidence scope.** Comparison of the deck's supplied audit and results snapshots. No fresh model execution or current-price verification. Arithmetic and task implications are editorial derivations, not additional benchmark measurements.
